entry.title: GAID hub
entry.body: Use analysis methods other researchers registered with your own data, or make a new method from your paper or code.

home.title: GAID hub
home.body: Use analysis methods other researchers registered with your own data, or make a new method from your paper or code.
home.empty: No methods yet. Upload a paper PDF or code to start.
home.error: Could not read the list. Open it again in a moment.
home.catalogueHint: {title} is a catalogue Workflow. Start it from the Workflow panel of a research project.

browse.title: Methods registered in the hub

search.label: Search registered methods
search.placeholder: Search title, tagline, author or taxonomy
search.hint: You can also search by element symbol (Ni) or method name (PU).

browse.error: Could not read registered methods. Reload the list.
browse.noResults: No methods match. Change the search term or folder.
browse.empty: No methods are registered. Browse the recommended analysis methods.

use.title: Use a registered method
use.body: Pick a method, install it in your project and start it with your data.

make.title: Make a method from your paper
make.body: Upload a paper or code and answer the questions to get a method draft.

method.text: The unit of analysis in the hub: one skill and, when present, one Workflow.

skill.text: Analysis instructions the AI agent follows. Some skills also include run code.

workflow.text: The steps to start a skill with your data. It asks for input files and values to set first.

recipe.text: Values chosen in advance for starting a Workflow, also called a recipe.

draft.text: A method not yet registered in the hub. It does not appear in other researchers' hub lists.

revision.text: The number that goes up each time a registered method is revised and registered again. Comments stay with their revision.

trial.text: A record of running the method in your project. It is not a review result.

sources.title: Upload sources
sources.drop: Drop a paper PDF or a code archive (.zip, .tar.gz).
sources.goalPlaceholder: e.g. an exploration method for grid data from another region
sources.noPdfText: The PDF page-text tool is missing, so PDF content cannot be read. You can continue with code or notes.
sources.urlPlaceholder: https://doi.org/… or a web page address
sources.urlNote: The server inside the institute network reads the address and keeps the text with the original.
sources.agentModelHint: Used to read the sources, ask questions and write the draft.
sources.readDone: The sources have been read. Next, answer the questions that decide the method.

reading.title: Reading sources
reading.received: {count, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}} received
reading.analysis: Finding the method and missing decisions
reading.note: Reading continues if you close this screen. Reopen it from 'Methods I made' on the hub home. A long paper takes several minutes or more.
reading.failed: Could not analyze the sources. Run it again.
reading.interrupted: The app restarted and the analysis stopped. Run it again.

questions.title: Answer questions
questions.reviewBody: All answers are applied together to create the draft.
questions.needAll: {count, plural, one {# question has} other {# questions have}} no answer. Answer or choose Decide later.
questions.allApplied: All answers are in the draft. Use "Request changes" on the draft screen to change something.

drafting.title: Creating the draft
drafting.note: Applying {count} answers. It continues if you close the screen.
drafting.reviseNote: Applying the changes you asked for. You can close this screen; it keeps running.

draft.checkFail: {count, plural, one {# issue} other {# issues}} to fix
draft.feedbackPlaceholder: Describe what to change, e.g. compute the variogram on at most 10,000 cells
draft.autoFix: Ask the agent to fix them

implementation.descriptiveHint: When you try it, the AI agent writes the analysis code from these instructions.

trial.title: Try in my research project first (optional)
trial.body: Install the draft into a project, prepare its inputs, then open the Workflow start settings.
trial.consent: I understand that the method to install can run code in the project.
trial.notReady: Fix the issues to try the draft.
trial.observed: {files, plural, one {# output file} other {# output files}} · {failed, plural, one {# failed tool call} other {# failed tool calls}}
trial.newer: Revision {n} of the draft is new. The tried revision is {installed}.

newProject.label: New project name
newProject.failed: Could not create the project. Change the name and create it again.

prep.noWorkflow: The installed method has no Workflow. Open the method from the project's Workflow panel.
prep.title: Inputs for {project}
prep.needInputs: Upload every required input and prepare the run environment to open the start settings.
prep.uploadFailed: Could not upload the file. Check the file and upload it again.
prep.extraPackages: Packages outside the prepared environment: {packages}. The AI agent installs them during the analysis as the skill describes. On a PC that blocks installation, those steps stop.

register.title: Register in the GAID hub
register.notePlaceholder: e.g. Built for grid data from other regions. Please try it and leave feedback.
register.shared: Shared: skill and Workflow files, method flow, check record, trial assessments
register.notShared: Not shared: the uploaded PDF and archive files, research data. Code placed in the package is shared.
register.line: Registered methods can be viewed, starred and discussed by other researchers. Check how it will look first.
register.registeredLine: Revision {n} is registered in the hub.
register.previewBanner: Preview: this is how other researchers will see it in the hub.
register.notYet: The shared hub store is connected after the screens are agreed. Preview only for now.

shared.trials: {count, plural, one {# trial started with registered revisions} other {# trials started with registered revisions}} (not a review)
shared.commentPlaceholder: Write what you found when you tried it, or what to fix.
shared.afterRegister: After registration, other researchers can star it and comment.

user.title: Name in the hub
user.body: The name shown on methods you make, registrations, stars and comments. It is saved in this browser.

overview.gates: {count, plural, one {# researcher decision} other {# researcher decisions}}

visuals.note: Concept illustration, not analysis data or results
visuals.title: Concept pictures
visuals.explanation: Illustrations of the method, not analysis data or results. They appear in the draft and hub registration.

source.record: Pictures are generated with gpt-image-2 through your OpenAI Codex (legacy) login only when you request them. They use that subscription's image quota, with no other picture source as a fallback. Sign in with ChatGPT does not support picture generation.

visuals.placeholder: e.g. larger blocks, a single colour
visuals.editHint: Sends the existing picture with your revision request. Up to 500 characters.
visuals.failed: Could not make the concept pictures. Make them again.
visuals.needLogin: No picture account is connected. Sign in with OpenAI Codex (legacy) in provider settings.
visuals.interrupted: Making pictures stopped. Make them again.
visuals.quota: Picture usage limit reached. Make them again once the limit resets.
visuals.quotaUntil: Picture usage limit reached. Make them again after {when, date, short} {when, time, short}.
